sources.title: mt5-base: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Named entity recognition and tagging in low-resource languages. For languages with limited supervised training data, mt5-base can be fine-tuned as a sequence labeling model (using text-to-text framing where tags are generated as sequences) and benefits from the multilingual pretraining.
